privacy_note: Aggregate-only release. No participant identifiers, individual outcomes, individual predictions, or row-level data are included.
study_design: Retrospective fixed-predictor evaluation with leakage-controlled internal cross-validation.

fixed_model_specification.role: Evaluation specification, not a deployable probability equation.
fixed_model_specification.imputation: Deterministic IterativeImputer fitted within each fold
fixed_model_specification.historical_selection_caveat: The historical feature-selection chain was not nested within the current cross-validation and cannot be fully reproduced.

patient_grouped_sensitivity.role: supportive sensitivity analysis; does not replace the V3 case-level primary evaluation
patient_grouped_sensitivity.uncertainty_note: Patient-level cluster bootstrap of fixed patient-grouped OOF predictions; the complete grouped cross-validation procedure was not repeated within bootstrap samples.

outcome_definition_audit.planned_status_note: The supplied analytic data contain ICU length of stay but no planned-versus-unplanned ICU admission field.

positive_fentanyl_selection_audit.implemented_rule: intraop_ftn > 0 in the historical cohort pipeline
positive_fentanyl_selection_audit.risk_note: This filter selects on recorded fentanyl exposure and restricts the target population; the supplied evidence does not establish a clinical eligibility rationale.

interpretation_guardrails: Use out-of-fold metrics as the primary internal performance estimates.
Average precision must be interpreted against the 5.0% event prevalence.
Protocol-consistency subsets assess the 11 Spinal and 18 Thoracic surgery cases; they do not address selection by positive recorded fentanyl.
The positive fentanyl filter selects on recorded exposure and restricts the target population.
The supplied data cannot distinguish planned from unplanned ICU admission.
Do not claim external validity, clinical utility, early warning, or reproducibility of the historical feature-selection chain.
